WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        toMonth(DateKey) AS month_num,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS total_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY month_num
    ORDER BY month_num
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT
        month_num,
        total_sales,
        lagInFrame(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month_num) AS prev_month_sales
    FROM monthly_sales
)
SELECT
    month_num,
    total_sales,
    prev_month_sales,
    round(
        (total_sales - prev_month_sales) * 100.0 / nullIf(prev_month_sales, 0),
        2
    ) AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY month_num
